author: Kyle S.
cleanText: I'm also banning myself from taking any positions with the intentions of day trading. Everything I enter will be a swing - if I need to exit same day, so be it, but majority should be held overnight. My results are better and I feel less stress swinging, but sometimes I can't help myself if I see strong moves. ABT is a good example today, although I still think it wasn't a bad trade, it had an awful D1 that I'm not willing to hold and I was forced to take the loss. I'd rather have confidence that I can weather out a couple bad days or even weeks.
